recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not add redundant text for FHIR-14143; if the duplicated prose currently present in the component.value[x] comment is worth cleaning up, handle it under a focused current issue rather than this already-applied STU3 QA tracker.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 OO change request for FHIR-core Observation. The resolution requested updates to the comments for Observation.value[x] and Observation.component.value[x] and noted that the updates were preapplied in the current build.
initial_application: Git history contains no literal FHIR-14143 commit, but git-svn commit 37fadcd59d927bffedca4bd6784338c0c73c6558 explicitly mentions GF#14143 and changes both Observation spreadsheet comment cells. Those changes introduced guidance that Observation.value[x] may be a single value, combined with related/component values, or represented through related/component values; that the observation code determines the value datatype; that CodeableConcept-with-text is preferred over string when a coded value is defined; and that the Observation notes provide more guidance. Later source migration preserved this guidance in structuredefinition-Observation.xml.
additional_context: Observation is active build input in source/fhir.ini. Current source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml retains the applied comment guidance at Observation.value[x] and Observation.component.value[x], with later same-area Observation comment edits adding attachment guidance and code/value interoperability cross-reference material. FHIR-50189 and FHIR-55270 were discovered as later same-comment-family issues, but they do not reverse the seed guidance; FHIR-50189 is outside this seed's default decision scope and FHIR-55270 is already represented separately on the combined branch. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active source already satisfies the FHIR-14143 request, so the combined branch received an empty audit commit documenting the no-change decision.
